leader_decision: #1012 samples the magnetic CPML profile at the Yee half cell; the empty guide's worst reflection at the fine rung falls from −42.8 dB to −55.8 dB, and every thru/short cell moves by up to 0.029. The slab cells are re-frozen from VESSL 369367264100 (arm B, commit 31531379, which contains #1213 and #1012). Their distance from the Airy reference at fine / mid / coarse (false normalization) is 0.0149 / 0.0607 / 0.287; the record they replace was 0.101 / 0.232 / 0.581.
scope: The six slab cells are re-frozen from run 369367264100 arm B. The 12 thru/pec_short cells and their provenance are retained from run 369367264028. Historical AD/FD, plane-shift, ladder, verdict and pin records remain in the schema-4 artifact.
